answer: Staked curation stops bulk fakes. Each newcomer is a vertex in the vouch graph. It docks at the jetty, where a curator stakes 50 credits vouching it is one real agent. The stake stays an ember one epoch while the identity works; a proven duplicate burns the 50, ejects it, and slashes a rented signature on the trail. Forging 1,000 sybils needs 1,000 bonds, 50,000 credits at risk. An honest agent stakes one bond once, refunded after a clean epoch.
